title: Critical GitLab Flaws Let Attackers Read Arbitrary Files, Steal Credentials and Execute Code
content_md: GitLab has issued an emergency security update to address two critical vulnerabilities that could lead to unauthenticated file disclosure and authenticated credential theft, as well as a high-severity flaw that may enable remote code execution.
